answer: A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a farm in one epoch however much capital it holds, because every identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The sable cap is enforced at intake and zenith shows the per-origin counts. At most 4 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a fable tag. That is 39 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
